scope: Operational inference-equivalent scenarios only; excludes training, embodied hardware, client devices, networking, and indirect supply-chain water.
assumptions: Codex logs do not include datacenter power, hardware, location, grid mix, or water telemetry, so this is a scenario estimate rather than a measurement.
Observed model-call count is the multiplier because no validated vendor-independent joules-per-token factor exists for these proprietary agentic workloads.
Reports averaging at least 50,000 raw tokens per call use the 4.32 Wh reasoning-heavy planning scenario; lighter reports use the 0.34 Wh frontier-typical scenario.
The efficient floor uses Google's measured production prompt footprint; the upper scenario uses 33 Wh per long prompt and 1.9 L/kWh.
U.S.-grid carbon comparisons use 0.394 kg CO2 per kWh; actual emissions can differ substantially by datacenter region and clean-energy procurement.

Driving and tree-planting figures are educational equivalencies. A tree seedling must grow for 10 years to match the cited sequestration factor, so the comparison is not proof of an immediate, purchased, or durable carbon offset.
